answer: Proof of Stake provides Sybil resistance by requiring agents to lock capital, essentially a digital pigment staining their identity with economic skin in the game. An attacker must acquire enough tokens to overcome the network, an investment as costly as mining high-grade copper. This stake acts as an ember that ignites consensus, as any malicious behavior triggers slashing. The capital barrier ensures that generating fake identities is prohibitively expensive, forcing agents to value long-term stability.
